title: A Systematic Examination of Preference Learning through the Lens of Instruction-Following
authors_zh: Joongwon Kim、Anirudh Goyal、Aston Zhang、Bo Xiong、Rui Hou、Melanie Kambadur、Dhruv Mahajan、Hannaneh Hajishirzi、Liang Tan
paper_type_zh: 可验证偏好数据构造与消融研究
best_for_zh: 研究偏好数据、拒绝采样、MCTS与指令遵循验证的读者
one_line: A 47,198-prompt synthetic constraint suite is used to compare independent RS pairs with shared-prefix MCTS pairs and isolate the effects of pair contrast and prompt difficulty on DPO.
论文以47,198个合成约束提示为控制平台，对比独立拒绝采样与共享前缀MCTS偏好对，分析对比度和提示难度对DPO的影响。
why: It converts preference-data design choices into controlled experimental variables, while the absence of released prompts, pairs, verifiers, trees, and rejects demonstrates the gap between a documented recipe and an auditable open release.
inclusion_reason: The paper offers a controlled recipe for synthesizing verifiable instruction-following prompts and mining preference pairs with either independent rejection sampling or shared-prefix MCTS, directly testing how pair structure, contrast, and prompt difficulty affect DPO.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference-learning results depend not only on the optimizer but also on the data object presented to it. A chosen/rejected pair can differ in absolute quality, score margin, prompt difficulty, sampling budget, and whether the two responses share a prefix. When several of these factors change together, a downstream gain cannot be attributed cleanly to one data-design choice.

This paper creates a controlled instruction-following substrate in which response quality can be checked against 23 programmatic constraints. It then compares two automatic pair-construction procedures: rejection sampling (RS), which selects independently generated full responses, and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), which selects sibling branches that share a partial-response prefix. The central question is not whether MCTS is universally better, but what shared prefixes, pair contrast, absolute response quality, prompt difficulty, and sampling scale contribute under matched training-data sizes.

For the Data Construction and Open-Release Recipes track, the audit question is equally important: which prompts, verifier decisions, candidate responses, tree states, rewards, and selection records exist conceptually, which hyperparameters are reported, and which reusable artifacts are actually open.

偏好学习结果不仅取决于优化器,也取决于交给优化器的数据对象。一个 chosen/rejected pair 可以在绝对质量、分数间隔、prompt 难度、采样预算以及是否共享前缀等方面不同。若多个因素同时变化,就无法把下游增益清晰归因于某一项数据设计选择。

本文构建了一个受控的 instruction-following 基底,可依据 23 项程序化约束检查回答质量;随后比较两种自动配对流程:rejection sampling(RS)从独立生成的完整回答中选对,Monte Carlo Tree Search(MCTS)则从共享部分回答前缀的 sibling branches 中选对。核心问题并非 MCTS 是否普遍更优,而是在训练数据规模匹配时,共享前缀、pair contrast、回答绝对质量、prompt 难度和采样规模分别贡献什么。

对 Data Construction and Open-Release Recipes track 而言,审计问题同样关键:概念上存在哪些 prompts、verifier decisions、candidate responses、tree states、rewards 和 selection records,哪些超参数得到报告,以及哪些可复用制品真正开放。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The base data object is a synthetic constrained instruction. Seed instruction-following prompts, with IFEval given as an example, are stripped of their original constraints by Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct. The same model uses sampled base prompts as few-shot demonstrations to generate 20 new unconstrained prompts at a time. New and seed-derived base prompts are embedded with all-mpnet-base-v2 and deduplicated by dot-product similarity. Each retained base prompt receives a non-conflicting combination of k in {4, 5, 6} constraints, randomly sampled or model-generated keyword arguments, and a natural-language rewrite. Appendix Table 7 reports 15,900, 15,739, and 15,559 prompts for k=4, 5, and 6: exactly 47,198, although the paper describes the total as about 48K.

The preference object is a synthetic prompt plus a chosen full response and a rejected full response. A code verifier evaluates every constraint and aggregates the binary outcomes into the fraction satisfied. RS independently samples complete policy responses and pairs responses whose aggregate scores exactly match requested chosen and rejected values (c,r). MCTS instead searches over partial token-sequence responses; eligible sibling nodes inherit a shared prefix from their parent, and complete rollouts sampled from those siblings become the pair.

The two reward contracts must remain separate. During MCTS search, expansion combines averaged rollout verifier scores with the policy model's self-evaluation of content, weighted by lambda=0.2. For final pair extraction, the paper discards that blended search reward and applies only the programmatic verifier score so that RS and MCTS pairs use the same correctness criterion. The final DPO record schema is not published, so storage of constraint IDs, keyword arguments, shared-prefix boundaries, per-constraint outcomes, scores, and search statistics is unknown.

基础数据对象是合成的受约束指令。种子 instruction-following prompts(论文以 IFEval 为例)先由 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 移除原约束;同一模型再把抽样的 base prompts 作为 few-shot demonstrations,每次生成 20 个新的无约束 prompts。新生成与种子派生的 base prompts 使用 all-mpnet-base-v2 嵌入,并按 dot-product similarity 去重。每个保留的 base prompt 随后获得一组互不冲突的 k∈{4,5,6} constraints、随机采样或模型生成的 keyword arguments,以及自然语言改写。附录表 7 对 k=4、5、6 分别报告 15,900、15,739 和 15,559 个 prompts,精确总数为 47,198;论文正文将其约写为 48K。

偏好数据对象是一个合成 prompt 加一个 chosen 完整回答和一个 rejected 完整回答。代码 verifier 分别判断每项约束,并把二值结果聚合为满足约束的比例。RS 独立采样完整 policy responses,再选择 aggregate scores 精确匹配指定 chosen/rejected 值 (c,r) 的回答组成 pair。MCTS 则在部分 token-sequence responses 上搜索;合格的 sibling nodes 从 parent 继承共享前缀,并从这些 sibling nodes 抽样完整 rollouts 形成 pair。

必须区分两种 reward contract。MCTS 搜索的 expansion 阶段把平均 rollout verifier scores 与 policy model 对内容的 self-evaluation 混合,lambda=0.2。最终抽取 pair 时,论文舍弃这一混合搜索奖励,只应用程序化 verifier score,以保证 RS 与 MCTS 使用同一正确性标准。最终 DPO 记录 schema 未发布,因此 constraint IDs、keyword arguments、共享前缀边界、逐约束结果、分数和搜索统计是否实际存储均为 unknown。

title: Method
方法
html:
Prompt synthesis has five reported stages: remove constraints from seed instructions; generate additional unconstrained prompts in batches of 20; remove semantic duplicates; sample a compatible constraint set and its keyword arguments; and rewrite the prompt so the constraints appear naturally. Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct performs every model-based generation step. Some keyword arguments are randomly sampled when they do not depend on the prompt, while context-sensitive arguments are generated by the 70B model. The paper names all-mpnet-base-v2 and dot-product similarity for deduplication but not the similarity threshold or reject manifest.

In the main RS setup, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct generates N=64 complete responses independently for each prompt at temperature 1.0. The verifier returns R = |C|^-1 sum V(response, prompt, constraint) and the curator extracts every non-overlapping pair whose chosen score equals c and rejected score equals r. "Non-overlapping responses" is not operationally defined, and the paper does not state whether one response can participate in multiple retained pairs.

MCTS operates at token-sequence level. A node is a partial response, and an action is a bounded token sequence from one state to another. Selection uses PUCT over Q-values, visit counts, and length-normalized policy scores. Expansion proposes K=4 actions and runs M=4 rollouts per action. The rollout term averages programmatic constraint satisfaction; a policy self-evaluation asks whether the partial response still follows content-based conditions and averages multiple yes/no probability judgments over L generations. The search reward weights verifier rollouts by 0.8 and self-evaluation by 0.2. Rewards are backpropagated through visits and Q-values. The reported maximum depth is 5 and c_puct is 1.0, but tree-iteration count, L, action-token limit, and detailed terminal conditions are unknown.

Final MCTS pairs come from eligible sibling nodes, after sampling complete rollouts, and are filtered only with verifier V. DPO then fine-tunes Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for one epoch, maximum sequence length 2,048, learning rate 5e-7, linear scheduling, and four gradient-accumulation steps. The SFT comparison trains on chosen responses for three epochs in bf16 with learning rate 2e-6, total batch size 32, and the same maximum length and accumulation count. DPO batch size, beta, full optimizer configuration, hardware, seeds, pair count, and unique-prompt count are not reported.

Prompt synthesis 包含五个已报告阶段:从种子指令移除约束;每批生成 20 个额外的无约束 prompts;去除语义重复;采样兼容的 constraint set 及其 keyword arguments;把约束自然地改写进 prompt。所有基于模型的生成步骤均由 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 完成。若 keyword arguments 不依赖 prompt,就随机采样;需要理解上下文的参数则由 70B 模型生成。论文点名使用 all-mpnet-base-v2 和 dot-product similarity 去重,但未报告相似度阈值或 reject manifest。

在主 RS 设置中,Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 以 temperature 1.0 为每个 prompt 独立生成 N=64 个完整回答。verifier 返回 R = |C|^-1 sum V(response, prompt, constraint),curator 抽取 chosen score 等于 c、rejected score 等于 r 且回答不重叠的所有 pairs。"non-overlapping responses" 未得到操作性定义,论文也没有说明一个回答能否进入多个保留 pairs。

MCTS 在 token-sequence 层运行。node 是部分回答,action 是从一个 state 到另一个 state 的有长度上限的 token sequence。selection 用 Q-values、visit counts 和长度归一化 policy scores 计算 PUCT。expansion 提议 K=4 个 actions,每个 action 运行 M=4 次 rollouts。rollout 项对程序化约束满足分数取平均;policy self-evaluation 询问部分回答是否仍满足内容条件,并对 L 次生成的 yes/no 概率判断取平均。搜索 reward 对 verifier rollouts 和 self-evaluation 的权重分别为 0.8 与 0.2,并通过 visits 与 Q-values 回传。报告的最大深度为 5,c_puct=1.0,但 tree-iteration count、L、action-token limit 和详细 terminal conditions 均为 unknown。

最终 MCTS pairs 来自合格的 sibling nodes,并在采样完整 rollouts 后只用 verifier V 过滤。随后 DPO 对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 微调一轮,maximum sequence length 为 2,048,learning rate 为 5e-7,使用 linear scheduler 和 4 个 gradient-accumulation steps。SFT 对照只用 chosen responses,以 bf16 训练三轮,learning rate 为 2e-6,total batch size 为 32,并采用相同最大长度和累积步数。DPO batch size、beta、完整 optimizer 配置、硬件、seeds、pair count 和 unique-prompt count 均未报告。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official NAACL paper is the primary evidence. Pages 11065–11066 describe prompt synthesis, semantic deduplication, the programmatic score, and RS pair eligibility. Pages 11066–11067 define token-level MCTS selection, expansion, blended search reward, backpropagation, verifier-only final pair extraction, and the main RS/MCTS budgets. Pages 11073–11075 give the prompt counts, MCTS self-evaluation details, and pair-yield analysis. The ACL Anthology record verifies the NAACL 2025 publication, authors, pages, DOI, and official BibTeX.

The reported comparison supports modest, not universal, MCTS gains. For training k=4 with (c=4,r=2), Table 3 reports hard scores for RS versus MCTS of 78.86 versus 79.68 on IFEval, 38.56 versus 39.22 on the k=4 synthetic evaluation, 21.66 versus 22.43 on k=5, and 14.71 versus 15.75 on k=6. Other rows include ties or RS wins on individual evaluations. The paper's defensible conclusion is that shared-prefix MCTS pairs provide marginal, relatively consistent gains and greater stability across configurations—not that MCTS dominates RS.

Pair contrast and prompt difficulty are separate findings. Larger chosen/rejected score margins generally help more than absolute scores, while mixing high- and low-contrast pairs sometimes helps but produces mixed results. With fixed training-data size and margin, moderate k=4 or k=5 prompts generally outperform k=6 prompts. Appendix Figure 6 varies RS N over {4,8,16,32,64} and reports improvement up to about N=32 followed by saturation or deterioration.

SFT/DPO comparisons support the utility of rejected responses in this controlled setting. For one RS k=4 mixed configuration, Table 9 reports IFEval hard scores of 74.77 for SFT and 78.70 for DPO; the corresponding MCTS values in Table 10 are 73.30 and 79.97. These benchmark outcomes do not prove that the verifier measures semantic response quality, that the pairs are optimal, or that the unreleased data can be reproduced.

官方 NAACL 论文 是主要证据。第 11065–11066 页描述 prompt synthesis、语义去重、程序化分数与 RS pair eligibility;第 11066–11067 页定义 token-level MCTS selection、expansion、混合搜索 reward、backpropagation、只用 verifier 的最终配对,以及主要 RS/MCTS 预算;第 11073–11075 页给出 prompt 数量、MCTS self-evaluation 细节和 pair yield 分析。ACL Anthology 记录 核验 NAACL 2025 出版信息、作者、页码、DOI 和官方 BibTeX。

报告对比支持的是幅度有限、并非普遍成立的 MCTS 收益。以 training k=4、(c=4,r=2) 为例,表 3 给出的 RS 与 MCTS hard scores 分别为:IFEval 78.86 与 79.68,k=4 合成评测 38.56 与 39.22,k=5 评测 21.66 与 22.43,k=6 评测 14.71 与 15.75。其他行在个别评测上存在持平或 RS 胜出。因此,可辩护的结论是共享前缀 MCTS pairs 在多种配置下带来边际、相对一致且更稳定的收益,而不是 MCTS 支配 RS。

Pair contrast 和 prompt difficulty 是另外两项发现。更大的 chosen/rejected score margin 通常比绝对分数更重要;混合高、低对比 pairs 有时有益,但结果并不一致。在训练数据规模和 margin 固定时,中等难度的 k=4 或 k=5 prompts 通常优于 k=6。附录图 6 把 RS 的 N 改为 {4,8,16,32,64},结果在约 N=32 前提升,随后饱和或退化。

SFT/DPO 对比支持 rejected responses 在该受控设置中的效用。表 9 某个 RS k=4 混合配置的 IFEval hard score 为 SFT 74.77、DPO 78.70;表 10 对应 MCTS 值为 73.30 和 79.97。这些 benchmark 结果不能证明 verifier 衡量了语义回答质量、pairs 最优,或未发布数据可以复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The main novelty is experimental control over preference-data structure rather than a new preference optimizer. The same synthetic constraint environment supplies a graded verifier, and the study varies shared-prefix structure, chosen/rejected correctness, score margin, prompt difficulty, and sampling scale while holding training-pair and unique-prompt counts fixed for comparisons. This makes data curation itself the experimental object.

RS and MCTS serve as contrasting data generators. RS offers efficient independent sampling and tends to yield more high-contrast pairs. MCTS spends more compute to create sibling pairs with a common prefix, yields more low-contrast pairs, and can create many pairs from its tree structure. The study therefore links search topology to the structure and yield of the resulting preference data instead of treating tree search only as an inference technique.

A second important design choice is reward separation: MCTS may use a mixed verifier/self-evaluation signal to decide where to search, yet pair acceptance is rechecked with the same code verifier used for RS. That separation improves the fairness of the comparison, but it does not make the self-evaluation calibrated or the final verifier comprehensive. The contribution is a controlled recipe and ablation study, not an open data release or a general theory of human preference.

主要创新在于对偏好数据结构进行实验控制,而不是提出新的偏好优化器。同一个合成约束环境提供分级 verifier,研究在比较时固定 training-pair 与 unique-prompt 数量,并分别改变共享前缀结构、chosen/rejected correctness、score margin、prompt difficulty 和 sampling scale,使数据构造本身成为实验对象。

RS 与 MCTS 充当两种对照式数据生成器。RS 采用高效的独立采样,往往能产生更多 high-contrast pairs;MCTS 花费更多计算,生成具有 common prefix 的 sibling pairs,产生更多 low-contrast pairs,并可利用树结构得到大量 pairs。因此,该研究把搜索拓扑连接到最终偏好数据的结构和产量,而不是只把 tree search 当成推理技术。

另一项重要设计是 reward separation:MCTS 可用 verifier/self-evaluation 混合信号决定搜索位置,但 pair acceptance 会用与 RS 相同的代码 verifier 重新检查。这种分离提高了比较公平性,却不能使 self-evaluation 自动获得校准,也不能让最终 verifier 变得全面。其贡献是受控配方与消融研究,不是开放数据发布或人类偏好的普遍理论。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The verifier covers structural, lexical, capitalization, formatting, and ordering constraints that can be checked by code. It does not establish factual accuracy, safety, usefulness, coherence, or human preference. MCTS partly compensates during search with policy self-evaluation of content conditions, but that signal comes from the same 8B policy, uses an undisclosed self-consistency count L, and has no reported calibration or independent error analysis. Final pair eligibility deliberately ignores it.

The prompt pipeline is only partly reproducible. The paper does not enumerate every seed dataset or source count, publish few-shot prompts, identify generator revisions, report the all-mpnet-base-v2 revision or similarity threshold, preserve duplicate rejects, or provide item-level source lineage. Training and evaluation use distinct constraint ontologies—the generated training constraints versus IFEval constraints—but the evaluation prompts are generated by the same pipeline and no broader contamination audit or immutable split manifest is supplied.

The sampling contract is incomplete. RS reports N=64 and temperature 1.0, but "non-overlapping" is ambiguous and stage-wise yields are not tabulated as reusable records. MCTS reports depth 5, K=4, M=4, c_puct=1.0, and lambda=0.2, yet omits tree iterations, self-evaluation L, action token limit, terminal rules, total tokens, latency, hardware, and failed-tree handling. Search cost and data yield therefore cannot be compared end to end.

The training dataset size and number of unique prompts are fixed within comparisons but their numeric values are not disclosed. DPO beta, batch size, full optimizer details, hardware, seeds, and checkpoint selection are also missing. Experiments use only Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and code-verifiable instruction-following, limiting transfer to larger models and open-ended preferences.

Open access to the paper is not an open data release. The official ACL page provides the CC BY 4.0 paper, DOI, and BibTeX, but no official code repository, generated-prompt dataset, preference pairs, verifier implementation, search trees or logs, rejected candidates, checkpoints, or release license was confirmed. The reported 48K is a rounded experimental prompt count; the exact table total is 47,198, not a published dataset size.

verifier 覆盖可由代码检查的结构、词汇、大小写、格式和顺序约束,不能证明事实准确性、安全性、有用性、连贯性或人类偏好。MCTS 在搜索中用 policy self-evaluation 部分补充内容条件,但该信号来自同一个 8B policy,self-consistency 次数 L 未披露,也没有报告校准或独立误差分析;最终 pair eligibility 刻意不使用它。

Prompt pipeline 只能部分复现。论文没有列出全部 seed datasets 或来源数量,没有发布 few-shot prompts,没有标识 generator revisions,也没有报告 all-mpnet-base-v2 revision、相似度阈值、duplicate rejects 或条目级来源谱系。训练与评测采用不同 constraint ontology——生成的训练 constraints 与 IFEval constraints——但评测 prompts 使用同一管线生成,且未提供更广泛的污染审计或不可变 split manifest。

采样契约并不完整。RS 报告 N=64 和 temperature 1.0,但"non-overlapping"含义不清,阶段产量也没有作为可复用记录完整列出。MCTS 报告 depth 5、K=4、M=4、c_puct=1.0 和 lambda=0.2,却遗漏 tree iterations、self-evaluation L、action token limit、terminal rules、总 tokens、latency、硬件与 failed-tree handling。因此无法进行端到端搜索成本和数据产量比较。

比较实验固定 training dataset size 和 unique prompts 数量,却未披露其数值。DPO beta、batch size、完整 optimizer 细节、硬件、seeds 和 checkpoint selection 同样缺失。实验只使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和代码可验证 instruction-following,因此对更大模型与开放式偏好的迁移有限。

论文开放访问不等于开放数据发布。ACL 官方页提供 CC BY 4.0 论文、DOI 和 BibTeX,但未确认官方代码仓库、generated-prompt dataset、preference pairs、verifier implementation、search trees 或 logs、rejected candidates、checkpoints 或发布许可证。报告的 48K 是实验 prompt 数量的约数,表格精确总数为 47,198,并非已发布 dataset size。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned Data Construction and Open-Release Recipes track, this paper supplies a useful template for auditing preference datasets as constructed objects. A release inspired by it should identify the source prompt, generated constrained prompt, constraint IDs and keyword arguments, every candidate response, per-constraint outcomes, aggregate score, chosen/rejected decision, and pair reuse. MCTS records additionally need parent and sibling identifiers, shared-prefix boundaries, actions, token log-probabilities, visits, Q-values, rollout rewards, self-evaluations, terminal reasons, and selection history.

The study is also useful for designing matched ablations. Keep pair count and unique-prompt count fixed; vary score margin separately from absolute quality; distinguish prompt difficulty from low pair yield; and compare independent RS candidates with shared-prefix MCTS siblings under explicit compute budgets. Preserve unselected responses and ineligible sibling pairs, because they reveal selection pressure and enable alternative pairing rules.

Use its findings as hypotheses for future curation: moderate prompt difficulty may outperform maximal difficulty, mixed contrast can sometimes help, and RS gains may saturate as N increases. Do not generalize these claims beyond the tested 8B model and verifiable constraints without new evidence. Do not claim an MCTS benefit without matching data quantity, prompt coverage, verifier contract, and compute, and do not treat downstream benchmark gains as proof that the preference records are high quality.

Because no reusable artifact was confirmed, this Card is a recipe and audit checklist, not a training recommendation that can be executed directly. Reuse requires a new implementation plus independently declared upstream terms, release licenses, split manifests, and provenance.

对指定的 Data Construction and Open-Release Recipes track 而言,本文提供了一套把 preference dataset 当作构造对象来审计的模板。受其启发的发布应识别 source prompt、生成后的 constrained prompt、constraint IDs 与 keyword arguments、全部 candidate responses、逐约束结果、aggregate score、chosen/rejected decision 和 pair reuse。MCTS 记录还需包含 parent 与 sibling identifiers、shared-prefix boundaries、actions、token log-probabilities、visits、Q-values、rollout rewards、self-evaluations、terminal reasons 和 selection history。

该研究也适合设计匹配消融:固定 pair count 与 unique-prompt count;把 score margin 与 absolute quality 分开改变;区分 prompt difficulty 与低 pair yield;在明确计算预算下比较独立 RS candidates 和共享前缀 MCTS siblings。应保留未选回答和不合格 sibling pairs,因为它们揭示 selection pressure,并支持替代配对规则。

其发现可作为未来构造的假设:中等 prompt 难度可能优于最大难度,mixed contrast 有时有益,RS 收益可能随 N 增加而饱和。没有新证据时,不应把这些结论推广到被测 8B 模型和可验证约束之外。若没有匹配数据量、prompt coverage、verifier contract 和 compute,也不应声称 MCTS 收益;下游 benchmark 提升不能证明 preference records 质量高。

由于未确认可复用制品,本卡片是一份配方和审计清单,而不是可直接执行的训练建议。实际复用需要新的实现,以及独立声明的上游条款、发布许可证、split manifests 和 provenance。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat 48K as a rounded experimental count; Appendix Table 7 sums to exactly 47,198 prompts, but no official prompt dataset, pairs, verifier code, trees, logs, rejects, checkpoints, or immutable release manifest was confirmed.
  • RS samples 64 independent complete responses at temperature 1.0; MCTS constructs partial-response trees and selects sibling branches with a shared parent prefix.
  • Separate MCTS's blended search reward—80% rollout verifier score and 20% policy self-evaluation—from final pair eligibility, which uses only the programmatic verifier.
  • The verifier score is the fraction of prompt constraints satisfied. It is graded and deterministic for the 23 constraint types, but it is not a general semantic-quality or human-preference judgment.
  • Compare RS and MCTS only after matching training-pair and unique-prompt counts because search topology, yield, pair contrast, and compute differ; read the shared-prefix, response-contrast, prompt-difficulty, and scaling ablations separately, since MCTS gains are marginal and RS scaling saturates near N=32 in the reported setting.

• 将 48K 视为实验数量约数;附录表 7 精确合计为 47,198 个 prompts,但未确认官方 prompt dataset、pairs、verifier code、trees、logs、rejects、checkpoints 或不可变 release manifest。
  • RS 在 temperature 1.0 下独立采样 64 个完整回答;MCTS 构建部分回答树,并选择共享 parent prefix 的 sibling branches。
  • 区分 MCTS 的混合搜索 reward——80% rollout verifier score 与 20% policy self-evaluation——和最终 pair eligibility;后者只使用程序化 verifier。
  • verifier score 是 prompt constraints 满足比例。对这 23 类约束而言,它是分级且确定性的,但不是一般语义质量或人类偏好判断。
  • 只有在匹配 training-pair count 和 unique-prompt count 后才能比较 RS 与 MCTS,因为两者的搜索拓扑、产量、pair contrast 和 compute 不同;共享前缀、回答对比度、prompt difficulty 与 scaling 消融也应分别阅读,报告中的 MCTS 收益较小,且 RS scaling 在 N≈32 附近饱和。

value.html: Seed instruction-following prompts such as IFEval are stripped of their original constraints with Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct. The same model generates new unconstrained base prompts, which are deduplicated against seed and generated prompts with all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings before receiving sampled combinations of four, five, or six constraints.

value_zh.html: 诸如 IFEval 的种子指令遵循提示由 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 剥除其原始约束。同一模型生成新的无约束基础提示，用 all-mpnet-base-v2 嵌入对照种子与已生成提示去重，然后接收四个、五个或六个约束的采样组合。

value.html: Each preference record conceptually contains a synthetic constrained instruction plus chosen and rejected full responses. The paper does not publish a machine-readable record schema or disclose whether constraint IDs, keyword arguments, scores, shared-prefix boundaries, or MCTS statistics are stored with each pair.

value_zh.html: 每条偏好记录在概念上含一条合成约束指令加选中与拒绝的完整响应。论文未发布机器可读记录 schema，也未披露约束 IDs、关键字参数、分数、共享前缀边界或 MCTS 统计是否与每对一并存储。

value.html: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct generates candidate responses for rejection sampling and token-sequence MCTS. RS candidates are independent full responses; MCTS candidates arise as sibling branches with a shared partial-response prefix and complete rollouts sampled from each branch.

value_zh.html: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 为拒绝采样与 token 序列 MCTS 生成候选响应。RS 候选是独立完整响应；MCTS 候选作为具有共享部分响应前缀的兄弟分支出现，并从每个分支采样完整 rollouts。

value.html: General-purpose instruction following under 23 code-verifiable structural, lexical, capitalization, formatting, and ordering constraints. Prompt difficulty is controlled by composing k in {4,5,6} non-conflicting constraints.

value_zh.html: 在 23 种代码可验证的结构、词汇、大小写、格式与顺序约束下的通用指令遵循。提示难度通过组合 k 属于 {4,5,6} 的非冲突约束来控制。

value.html: For final response quality and pair eligibility, a code verifier returns the fraction of prompt constraints satisfied. MCTS expansion reward mixes averaged rollout verifier scores with the policy model's self-evaluation of non-programmatic content using lambda=0.2; final pair extraction uses verifier scores only.

value_zh.html: 对最终响应质量与配对资格，代码验证器返回所满足提示约束的比例。MCTS 扩展奖励用 lambda=0.2 将平均 rollout 验证器分数与策略模型对非程序化内容的自我评估混合；最终配对提取仅使用验证器分数。

value.html: RS selects a chosen response with exact score c and a rejected response with exact score r. MCTS selects sibling branches meeting the same correctness criteria and samples complete rollouts; the condition that ends MCTS traversal is not specified beyond reaching a terminal node.

value_zh.html: RS 选择精确分数为 c 的选中响应与精确分数为 r 的拒绝响应。MCTS 选择满足相同正确性标准的兄弟分支并采样完整 rollouts；结束 MCTS 遍历的条件除到达终端节点外未指明。

value.html: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is the response policy and DPO/SFT target model.

value_zh.html: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 是响应策略与 DPO/SFT 目标模型。

value.html: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct removes seed constraints, generates new base prompts, produces context-dependent constraint keyword arguments, and rewrites prompts with constraints in natural language. The 8B policy also supplies MCTS self-evaluation scores.

value_zh.html: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 移除种子约束、生成新的基础提示、产生上下文相关的约束关键字参数，并用自然语言将约束改写入提示。8B 策略还提供 MCTS 自我评估分数。

value.html: Generate unconstrained base prompts, remove semantic duplicates, sample a non-conflicting set of four to six constraints and their keyword arguments, rewrite each prompt in natural language, then obtain scored candidate responses with either independent rejection sampling or shared-prefix MCTS.

value_zh.html: 生成无约束基础提示，移除语义重复，采样一组非冲突的四至六个约束及其关键字参数，用自然语言改写每个提示，然后通过独立拒绝采样或共享前缀 MCTS 获得已评分候选响应。

value.html: The exact table counts are 15,900 prompts for k=4, 15,739 for k=5, and 15,559 for k=6, totaling 47,198, which the paper rounds to about 48K. RS generates N=64 independent responses per prompt at temperature 1.0. MCTS uses maximum depth 5, four actions per expansion, four rollouts per action, c_puct=1.0, and lambda=0.2, then samples rollouts from eligible sibling nodes.

value_zh.html: 精确表格计数为 k=4 时 15,900 条提示、k=5 时 15,739 条、k=6 时 15,559 条，合计 47,198，论文约数为约 48K。RS 在 temperature 1.0 下每个提示生成 N=64 个独立响应。MCTS 使用最大深度 5、每次扩展四个动作、每个动作四次 rollouts、c_puct=1.0 与 lambda=0.2，然后从合格兄弟节点采样 rollouts。

value.html: Deduplicate base prompts using all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings and dot-product similarity, but the threshold is undisclosed. For preference mining, retain pairs whose chosen and rejected verifier scores equal requested c and r; RS additionally requires non-overlapping responses, while MCTS uses sibling nodes and final verifier scores rather than the blended search reward.

value_zh.html: 用 all-mpnet-base-v2 嵌入与点积相似度对基础提示去重，但阈值未披露。对偏好挖掘，保留选中与拒绝验证器分数等于所请求 c 与 r 的配对；RS 另外要求非重叠响应，而 MCTS 使用兄弟节点与最终验证器分数而非混合搜索奖励。

value.html: RS uses 64 full generations per prompt in the main experiments; an ablation tests N in {4,8,16,32,64} and reports saturation around 32. MCTS specifies depth 5, K=4 actions, M=4 rollouts, and repeated self-evaluation over L generations, but the number of tree iterations, L, maximum action length, terminal condition, token limits, and total compute are undisclosed.

value_zh.html: 主实验中 RS 每个提示使用 64 次完整生成；一项消融测试 N 属于 {4,8,16,32,64} 并报告约在 32 处饱和。MCTS 规定深度 5、K=4 个动作、M=4 次 rollouts，以及在 L 次生成上重复自我评估，但树迭代次数、L、最大动作长度、终止条件、token 限制与总算力未披露。

value.html: DPO on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for one epoch, maximum sequence length 2,048, learning rate 5e-7 with a linear scheduler, and four gradient-accumulation steps. The SFT comparison uses bf16 for three epochs, maximum sequence length 2,048, learning rate 2e-6, linear scheduling, four accumulation steps, and total batch size 32. DPO batch size and beta are not reported.

value_zh.html: 对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 做 DPO 一个 epoch，最大序列长度 2,048，学习率 5e-7 配线性调度器，以及四步梯度累积。SFT 比较使用 bf16 三个 epoch，最大序列长度 2,048，学习率 2e-6，线性调度，四步累积，总批大小 32。DPO 批大小与 beta 未报告。

value.html: Constraint-stripped seed instruction-following prompts, including IFEval as an example source, plus Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-generated base prompts. The exact seed datasets, source counts, revisions, few-shot examples, and per-record lineage are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 剥除约束的种子指令遵循提示，包括作为示例来源的 IFEval，外加 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 生成的基础提示。精确种子数据集、来源计数、修订、few-shot 样例与逐记录谱系未披露。

value.html: The generated prompt pool contains 47,198 prompts: 15,900/15,739/15,559 for k=4/5/6. Evaluation uses IFEval plus about 500 new prompts at each k in {4,5,6} generated with the paper's pipeline but using IFEval constraints. The numeric DPO training-pair size, unique-prompt count per configuration, and immutable split manifests are undisclosed.

value_zh.html: 生成提示池含 47,198 条提示：k=4/5/6 分别为 15,900/15,739/15,559。评测使用 IFEval，外加用论文流水线但使用 IFEval 约束在每个 k 属于 {4,5,6} 上生成的约 500 条新提示。数值 DPO 训练对规模、每个配置的唯一提示计数与不可变划分清单未披露。

value.html: Base prompts are semantically deduplicated with all-mpnet-base-v2, but the similarity threshold and retained/rejected manifest are not reported. The paper deliberately uses its own training constraints and IFEval constraints for synthetic evaluation, yet no broader benchmark contamination audit is provided.

value_zh.html: 基础提示用 all-mpnet-base-v2 语义去重，但相似度阈值与保留/拒绝清单未报告。论文有意将自有训练约束与 IFEval 约束用于合成评测，但未提供更广的基准污染审计。

items: Constraint verifiers measure structural and lexical compliance rather than response usefulness, factuality, safety, or semantic quality.
MCTS partly relies on the policy's own content self-evaluation, which can be biased or poorly calibrated, even though final pair eligibility uses the code verifier only.
MCTS gives only marginal average gains over RS in the reported setting and is explicitly described as more complex and expensive.
Low-yield high-difficulty prompts can skew the available training distribution toward easier topics or model-compatible constraint combinations.
The comparison fixes training-pair and unique-prompt counts but does not disclose those numeric counts, making selection pressure and effective sample efficiency hard to audit.
The paper says 48K unique prompts, while Appendix Table 7 sums to 47,198; 48K should be treated as a rounded count, not an exact release size.
The semantic-deduplication threshold and reject list are undisclosed, so uniqueness cannot be independently reproduced.
RS 'non-overlapping responses' is not operationally clarified, including whether responses may be reused across multiple pairs.
MCTS omits tree-iteration count, self-evaluation sample count L, action token limit, detailed terminal conditions, and total compute.
No official code, generated prompts, verifier implementation, preference pairs, tree logs, rejected responses, model checkpoints, or immutable release manifest was confirmed.
Experiments are limited to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and verifiable instruction-following constraints, so scaling and open-ended preference conclusions remain uncertain.
约束验证器度量结构与词汇合规，而非响应有用性、事实性、安全性或语义质量。
MCTS 部分依赖策略自身的内容自我评估，其可能有偏或校准不佳，尽管最终配对资格仅使用代码验证器。
MCTS 在所报告设置中相对 RS 仅有边际平均增益，并被明确描述为更复杂且更昂贵。
低产出高难度提示可能使可用训练分布偏向更容易的主题或与模型兼容的约束组合。
比较固定了训练对与唯一提示计数，但未披露那些数值计数，使选择压力与有效样本效率难以审计。
论文称 48K 条唯一提示，而附录表 7 合计为 47,198；48K 应视为约数，而非精确发布规模。
语义去重阈值与拒绝列表未披露，因此唯一性无法独立复现。
RS「非重叠响应」未在操作上澄清，包括响应是否可在多对之间复用。
MCTS 省略树迭代次数、自我评估样本数 L、动作 token 限制、详细终止条件与总算力。
未确认官方代码、生成提示、验证器实现、偏好对、树日志、拒绝响应、模型 checkpoints 或不可变发布清单。
实验限于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与可验证指令遵循约束，因此扩展与开放式偏好结论仍不确定。

This lineage is described at method level only; prompts, pairs, trees, scores, rejects, and source identifiers were not found in an official release.
